verdict.rationale: Direct hands-on probe evidence confirms Discord's developer docs serve a working llms.txt index (HTTP 200) and per-page .md variants, with the .md page itself pointing agents to the llms.txt index for full documentation traversal — exactly the agent-oriented docs pattern requested. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI/machine-readable schema (openapi.json 404s) and no independent/community confirmation of agents actually consuming llms.txt successfully.
